title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, NFTs, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Nasdaq moves to remove position limits on Bitcoin, Ether ETF options
summary: The filing with the US SEC seeks to eliminate contract caps on crypto ETF options, a change Nasdaq argues would address unequal treatment in derivatives markets.

title: Trump sues JPMorgan in Florida court for $5B over debanking claims: Report
summary: The lawsuit was filed days after the president threatened on social media to sue the banking giant for debanking him weeks after his supporters attacked the US Capitol in 2021.

title: Stablecoin supply growth stalls as regulation, Treasury yields bite
summary: Institutional compliance costs and higher Treasury yields are reshaping stablecoin issuance as growth shifts from rapid expansion to balance-sheet discipline.

title: Tennessee city clears path for crypto mining, data centers with new zoning rules
summary: An ordinance to amend the city’s zoning laws laid out guidelines for where a crypto miner could operate in the area and how loud the operation could be.

title: Coinbase forms board to assess quantum computing risks to blockchain
summary: The independent advisory board, comprising researchers and industry experts, plans to publish papers on digital-security risks and guidance for developers, organizations and users.

title: Circle CEO says USDC is a neutral layer, not a rival to Visa or Mastercard
summary: At Davos, Jeremy Allaire said Circle's stablecoin functions as shared infrastructure rather than a competitor to banks or card networks.

title: Bitwise launches actively managed ETF pairing Bitcoin with gold
summary: An actively managed fund blends Bitcoin, precious metals and mining stocks as asset managers expand crypto’s role in macro and capital-preservation strategies.

title: 17K Bitcoin inflow to exchanges raises alarm: Will BTC’s sell-off deepen?
summary: The Bitcoin price rally to $90,000 failed to hold after 17,000 BTC were sent to exchanges, but an improving spot market suggests that traders view BTC’s current pricing as discounted.

title: Solana-based Natix brings DePIN data into self-driving AI with Valeo
summary: Natix and Valeo are building a decentralized, self-driving camera model to offer a transparent foundation for the safe mainstream deployment of physical AIs.
